treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the Italian Republic and the Government of the State of Kuwait for the avoidance of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and for the prevention of fiscal evasion (1987, corrected 1989, as amended by Protocol 1998)
eif_quote: Kuwait ... Stipula - Firma: Roma 17.12.1987; Ratifica: L. 07.01.1992, n.53 Protocollo di correzione - Firma: Roma 15.12.1989; Ratifica: L.07.01.1992, n.53 In vigore dal : 11.01.1993
source_title: Convenzione Italia–Kuwait 1987 (G.U. suppl. ord. n. 28, 4-2-1992, L. 53/1992) and Protocollo di modifica 17.3.1998 (G.U. n. 266, 12-11-1999, L. 413/1999), finanze.gov.it scans

rates.quote: 1. Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

2. Tuttavia, tali canoni sono imponibili anche nello Stato contraente dal quale essi provengono ed in conformità alla legislazione di detto Stato, ma se la persona che percepisce i canoni ne è l'effettivo beneficiario, l'imposta così applicata non può eccedere il 10 per cento dell'ammontare lordo dei canoni.

rates.article: Article 10(2) as amended by Protocol 1998 Art. 3
rates.quote: 2. However, if the beneficial owner of the dividends holds, directly or indirectly, 75% or more of the capital of the company paying the dividends, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 5% of the gross amount of the dividends.

ppt.basis: treaty Additional Protocol para. (m) (inserted by 1998 Protocol Art. 6)
ppt.quote: (m) Notwithstanding any other provision of this Convention, a resident of a Contracting State shall not receive the benefit of any reduction in or exemption from taxes provided for in this Convention by the other Contracting State if the main purpose of the creation, or existence of such resident or any person connected with such resident, was to obtain benefits under this Convention that would not otherwise be available.

notes: Art. 29(2)(a): original Convention applies to WHT on amounts realised on/after 1 Jan 1984 (retroactive; EIF 11-01-1993). Protocol 1998 Art. 7(1)(a): effective for WHT on amounts paid/credited on/after 1 Jan of the year following its EIF; Protocol EIF 25-03-2000 (secondary source tutorfiscale.eu; finanze.gov.it list does not show the 1998 Protocol) -> 2001-01-01. Dividends: Art. 10(1) gives residence State the right, and Art. 10(2) allows source taxation (cap 5%) only where the beneficial owner holds directly or indirectly >=75% of capital (25% before the 1998 Protocol); for smaller holdings the treaty gives the source State no taxing right, modelled as exclusive (interpretation of structure, not an express 'only'). Royalty definition includes industrial/commercial/scientific equipment and know-how; excludes technical-assistance fees. The treaty-level anti-abuse rule (Protocol para. (m)) is a main-purpose test on the creation/existence of the resident, not the MLI Art. 7 PPT. MLI: Italy and Kuwait both signatories, not Parties -> no MLI. [curated: DIVIDEND 5% tier above 75% used as the general rate — a higher rate for larger holdings is not modelled]
unverified: 1998 Protocol EIF date 2000-03-25 from secondary source
Exclusive treatment of dividends below 75% holding is a structural reading of Art. 10
